fields.why: 2020 rates are ranked across race/ethnicity groups, age groups and urbanization levels ('highest', 'inversely related'), and across race x sex x age cells ('Subgroups with the highest suicide rates').
Race/ethnicity, age and rurality each have 3+ levels ranked; sex enters through the ranked race x sex x age cells, which rule 3 counts because the cells are ranked as one set.

The z-tests and the gamma CI-overlap rule are stated only for 2019 vs 2020 differences within groups (rule 6), so the between-group 'highest' rankings rest on no test. The mechanical flags are false alarms.
